project.name: web
project.productType: agent-facing verification APIs (citations, code, live facts) on Pocket Network

design.concept: The Highlighter (Refero research 2026-10-06: Superthread primary; Val Town code card + Deep Midnight; Aaply lemon + black pair; Convex framed console; cdr-kit pills and facts row). A cool near-white canvas, midnight ink type at heavy weight, one vivid lemon marker, elevated white cards, a Deep-Midnight console.
design.colorMode: light by default; dark (midnight) via the .dark class from next-themes; .console is a scoped dark theme for machine output and the one showcase band

colors.background: var(--background) oklch(0.985 0.002 250) · dark oklch(0.15 0.015 260); --band for alternating sections
colors.foreground: var(--foreground) midnight ink oklch(0.21 0.02 265) · dark oklch(0.96 0.004 250)
colors.marker: var(--marker) lemon oklch(0.92 0.19 102) · dark oklch(0.88 0.17 100): CTA fill, the hero stroke, the active tab, console values; never body text
colors.primary: = the ink: the black button and dark active pills
colors.link: var(--link) cobalt oklch(0.45 0.17 258): text links and the docs' active nav only
colors.console: var(--console) Deep Midnight oklch(0.26 0.03 260) · dark oklch(0.12 0.02 260): the readout, code, the Pocket band
colors.verdicts: --verdict-verified 青磁 · --verdict-mismatch 琥珀 · --verdict-not-found 朱 · --verdict-retracted 紅 · --verdict-ambiguous 藤 · --verdict-unknown grey; the *-dark set reads on the console and in dark mode; all ≥ 4.5:1 (D-024)

typography.data: var(--font-mono) Geist Mono 400–600: .label (11.5 px uppercase, tracking 0.12em), pills (12.5 px), codes, timings, JSON
typography.mark: var(--font-mark) Shippori Mincho B1 800: 証 and the kanji index (典 符 今) only

motion.signature: the marker stroke draws under the hero keyword once (700 ms); VerdictStamp presses 1.08 → 1 with an ink bloom; readout glyphs pop (SPRING_POP); cards lift 2 px on hover; the desk strip sweeps while running
motion.reduced: prefers-reduced-motion gives cross-fades only; the stroke is drawn

design.density: comfortable: cards and pills, bands instead of rules, big type

adapted: Text Highlighter 18772 → components/ui/marker-stroke (one SVG path, CSS-drawn)
Segmented Tabs 26923 + Superthread tabs → features/desk/ModeTabs (dark active tab)
useAutoResizeTextarea 1097 + Val Town code card → features/desk/DeskInput
patterns: .card (+ .card-hover) for records and interactive cells; .well for a data strip inside a card; .console for machine output
.btn .btn-marker (lemon) / .btn-ink (black) / .btn-white; .pill variants; .eyebrow-bar + .label above a section title; .key + MarkerStroke for the hero keyword
a verdict is always glyph + word + colour (VerdictStamp: a tinted pill, TONE_PILL)

must: Tokens only: no hex, rgb or px literals in TSX; colours through theme utilities or var(--token)
Lemon is the marker: CTA fill, hero stroke, active tab, console values; never body text, never a verdict
Verdicts are glyph + word + colour, never colour alone
Dark and light from the same rules (.dark and .console overrides in packages/brand/tokens/theme.css)
Constants, not magic numbers (ESLint @typescript-eslint/no-magic-numbers); files ≤ 400 lines
Real Akashi examples and copy, never lorem ipsum
avoid: grey canvases, serif display, 2 px corners, underline-as-emphasis, italic word swaps
glassmorphism beyond the nav's blur; gradients beyond the lemon button; purple
Tailwind palette colour utilities (text-blue-500 …) and pasted HTML
a second vivid accent in marketing surfaces; scroll-reveal on sections

decisions.summary: Verdict tokens pass AA in both themes; the *-dark set is reused on the console
One primitive family per app: web uses shadcn radix-nova; docs uses Fumadocs' Base UI build

UI revamp v2 'The Highlighter' after the user rejected the v1 ledger: cool white canvas, midnight ink, lemon marker, Deep-Midnight console, 10/16/20 radii, three soft shadows, Gabarito / Instrument Sans / Geist Mono. Lock + ledger in docs/plan/specs/ui-revamp.md

Hero: pills, Gabarito 800 headline with a hand-drawn lemon stroke under the keyword, lemon + black CTA pair, ✦ facts row; the desk as a code card (header bar, dark active tabs, lemon Check); exhibits as white chips
Readout: Deep-Midnight card with a lemon top edge, route + per-item timings + verdict bar; evidence: white cards with the verdict as a tinted pill and data rows in a well; sources: a card of rows

Story: bands alternate canvas / band, lemon eyebrow bar, stat cards, lemon-badged steps, the Pocket relay in the one Deep-Midnight band (radius 20), service cards with lemon kanji tiles, nested envelope cards, the receipt
Docs: same tokens; fd-primary = cobalt (links, active nav); landing with pills, lemon/black/white CTAs, start-here cards, the curl quickstart on the console; titles in Gabarito
≥ 1100 px: evidence | sources card (18 rem, sticky); below: sources under the cards. Stat cards 1 / 2 / 4; service cards 1 / 3; steps 1 / 2 / 4. Nav anchors from md; the Docs button always
